cases.purpose: Verify an unavailable rollback backend fails without altering the package or unrelated state.
cases.oracle: The transaction belongs to an external installer; without an executable backend pkg must report failure and leave the fixture bytes intact. This does not establish real installer rollback.
cases.setup_script: [[ ! -x /bash-os/bl-pkg.sh ]] || { echo "CONTROL-FAILED image backend takes precedence" >&2; exit 98; }
cases.candidate_script:
export BASHPKG_BLPKG_PATH="$HOME/does-not-exist"
builtin pkg rollback txn-real1 --root root > "$HOME/rollback.out" 2> "$HOME/rollback.err"
printf "rollback=%s\n" "$?"
[[ $(<root/usr/share/realpkg/file) == "installed by txn-real1" && $(<root/var/lib/bl-pkg/installed/realpkg) == "txn=txn-real1" && $(<root/usr/share/unrelated/keep) == keep ]] && echo tree=unchanged || echo tree=changed
[[ -s "$HOME/rollback.err" ]] && echo diagnostic=yes || echo diagnostic=no
